# Elm w Noor

> Bilingual (Arabic/English) education guidance website focused on studying in Malaysia, with practical student support information, university guidance, life guides, and service details for Arab students and families.

Use this file as the primary map for understanding site content. The Arabic and English sections are parallel in structure, but some pages may contain mixed-language text. Prefer the language path that matches the user request:

- Arabic content path: /ar/
- English content path: /en/

For quick answers, start with homepage, services, universities, and guides. Use article pages for deeper context and detailed Q&A-style information.

## Primary Pages (Arabic)

- [Arabic Home](https://elmnoor.com/ar/): Main entry point, value proposition, majors overview, and primary calls to action.
- [Arabic Services](https://elmnoor.com/ar/services.html): Service catalog including university application support, visa help, accommodation, and student integration support.
- [Arabic Universities](https://elmnoor.com/ar/universities.html): University listing and program/cost-related reference content.
- [Arabic Life Guide](https://elmnoor.com/ar/life-in-malaysia-student-guide.html): Practical student life guidance (housing, safety, expenses, adaptation).
- [Arabic Computer Science Guide](https://elmnoor.com/ar/computer-science-guide.html): Specialized major guide for CS/IT pathways, admissions, fees, and FAQs.
- [Arabic Articles](https://elmnoor.com/ar/articles.html): Long-form strategic article content with structured sections and FAQs.

## Primary Pages (English)

- [English Home](https://elmnoor.com/en/): Main entry point, services summary, majors overview, and contact paths.
- [English Services](https://elmnoor.com/en/services.html): Detailed service descriptions and support flow.
- [English Universities](https://elmnoor.com/en/universities.html): University and program overview content.
- [English Life Guide](https://elmnoor.com/en/life-in-malaysia-student-guide.html): Student living guide in Malaysia with practical adaptation advice.
- [English Computer Science Guide](https://elmnoor.com/en/computer-science-guide.html): Computer science and IT major planning guide.
- [English Articles](https://elmnoor.com/en/articles.html): Long-form strategic education and safety content with FAQ-style coverage.

## Technical and Crawl Resources

- [Sitemap](https://elmnoor.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL inventory for discovery and crawling.
- [Robots](https://elmnoor.com/robots.txt): Crawl directives and sitemap pointer.
